description: This source file defines a utility class 'CreditCardUtils' providing methods related to credit card number masking and constants for card types.

classes.name: CreditCardUtils
classes.description: A utility class for handling credit card operations, such as masking card numbers and defining card type constants.

methods.name: maskCardNumber
methods.description: Masks a credit card number by preserving the first four and last four digits, replacing the middle with X's. Throws an exception if input length is less than 10.
